items.title: Albert Francis Interview, 1961-08-04
items.q: That's the band that Milly Bond had, Camellia Band.

ctx.x: I believe it was, maybe Camellia Band or some...
That's the band that Milly Bond had, Camellia Band. But before that, it wasn't a Camellia Band.
It wasn't, I don't remember a word, but...
